Built on open source. Clear about the details.

ClawPort is an independent discovery layer. This catalog includes agent runtimes, coding tools and inference engines. Model weights are obtained separately. Some projects have source-available licenses; check the license before reuse. A matching filename is a compatibility hint, not a device test. No APK or desktop installer is fabricated, and no software installs silently.
